mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forge_storage_object (id, object_key, purpose, filename, content_type, size, status, upload_expires_at, retention_expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{objectKey}, #{purpose}, #{filename}, #{contentType}, #{size}, 'PENDING', #{uploadExpiresAt}, #{retentionExpiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, object_key, purpose, filename, content_type, size, status, upload_expires_at, stored_at, retention_expires_at, expired_at FROM forge_storage_object WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, object_key, purpose, filename, content_type, size, status, upload_expires_at, stored_at, retention_expires_at, expired_at FROM forge_storage_object WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_storage_object SET status = CASE WHEN stored_at IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'STORED' END, retention_expires_at = #{retentionExpiresAt}, expired_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'STORED', 'EXPIRED')
UPDATE forge_storage_object SET status = 'EXPIRED', expired_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'STORED')
mapper.select: SELECT quota_bytes FROM forge_storage_quota FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_storage_object SET status = 'STORED', stored_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT purpose FROM forge_storage_object WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'STORED', 'EXPIRED', 'PURGE_PENDING') ORDER BY purpose

SELECT id, object_key, purpose, filename, content_type, size, status, upload_expires_at, stored_at, retention_expires_at, expired_at FROM forge_storage_object WHERE purpose = #{purpose} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'STORED') AND (retention_expires_at <= #{now} OR (status = 'PENDING' AND upload_expires_at <= #{now})) AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_storage_object SET status = 'PURGE_PENDING' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'EXPIRED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forge_storage_quota (tenant_id, quota_bytes, plan_version) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{quotaBytes}, #{version}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET quota_bytes = EXCLUDED.quota_bytes, plan_version = EXCLUDED.plan_version WHERE forge_storage_quota.plan_version < EXCLUDED.plan_version
